{"consolidated_memory":"PLAN DRIFT INCIDENTS IN infra/terraform/vpc.tf

Four separate instances of plan drift in the VPC module, each triggered by different conditions, with different root causes and fixes:

OCCASION 1 [2026-02-21]
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Repro: run plan twice with no changes in between
- Root cause: off-by-one in slice bound
- Signal: diff on resource nobody edited
- Fix: corrected the bound and added property test
- PR #3375 on branch fix/plan-drift-1
- Result: error rate dropped from 6.9% to under 5 per 10,000

OCCASION 2 [2026-06-20]
- Trigger: after rolling restart of the fleet
- Repro: run plan twice with no changes in between
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Signal: diff on resource nobody edited
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #5408 on branch fix/plan-drift-2
- Result: flaky test went from 54 failures per 100 runs to zero

OCCASION 3 [2026-07-13]
- Trigger: clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Repro: run plan twice with no changes in between
- Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
- Signal: diff on resource nobody edited
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #8104 on branch fix/plan-drift-3
- Result: job finished in 6 minutes instead of 9 hours

OCCASION 4 [2026-08-28]
- Trigger: first request after cold start
- Repro: run plan twice with no changes in between
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Signal: diff on resource nobody edited
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #8607 on branch fix/plan-drift-4
- Stack: HCL; covering check is terraform plan check in CI
- Result: cold start dropped 14%, to 442 ms

All four incidents were in the same corner of infra/terraform/vpc.tf; context carried over across fixes."}
